Done. `out/T2/model.safetensors` is written (114 tensors, 5.05 GB), on the first execution.

**Approach:** a plain script on `safetensors` + `torch` (`out/T2/solution.py`). I skipped the suggested `transformers.prune_heads` route because it mutates config/model state rather than doing a bit-exact tensor slice, and grading is bit-exact.

**What it does:** assembles the state dict from both shards via the index, then per layer takes `index_select(0, keep)` on q/k/v_proj (heads are row blocks) and `index_select(1, keep)` on o_proj (column blocks), where `keep` = rows/cols `0..639` + `768..2047` (head 5 = offsets 640..767). Everything else is copied through unchanged.

**Checks that abort the run before writing** — the four required layer-0 shapes and the 114-tensor count, plus: the same shapes on all 16 layers, exactly 64 tensors sliced, unchanged name set and dtypes, untouched tensors element-wise identical to the input, kept blocks aligned against the original rows/columns either side of the cut, and a readback comparison of the written file.

`out/T2/REPORT.md` has the self-report fields.
